content.what_it_is: MATLAB bathymetry generator for the FUNWAVE-TVD sediment_rip case; byte-identical (same source SHA-256) to rip_tracking/bathy/makebath.m. Header states it generates bathymetry for the TVD-Boussinesq model to study symmetry breaking in periodic bathymetry and sediment (L3-L4). ncell=2 periodic cells (L10), ycell=100 (L14), xcell=60 (L18); dx=1, dy=2, beach slope s=1/30, channel center xc=100, Gaussian amplitude a=1.5, sig2=xc*xc/4, anisotropy bet=2 (L22); x=-11..300, y cell-centered dy/2..199 (L23), meshgrid (L24). Planar depth h=s*xx (L27); rip channel centers yc=(0:ncell)*ycell (L31); commented symmetry-breaking shift (L33-L35); subtracts ncell+1 anisotropic Gaussians (L37-L41); clips depth at 8 m (L43); quick contour with levels 0..10 (L45-L47); saves ASCII depth_a15.txt (L49); then a 6x6 inch figure with pcolor of -h and white contours at -10..0 (L51-L64).
entities: ncell number of periodic cells L10
xx, yy meshgrid L24 (reassigned as 1D vectors L56-L57)

equations.ref: anisotropic Gaussian depression per cell center

unresolved: byte-identical duplicate of rip_tracking/bathy/makebath.m; which case the parameters (ncell=2, xcell=60, 8 m cap) were originally tuned for cannot be determined from the file

the commented symmetry-breaking line yc(ncell/2) (L35) would address yc(1) for ncell=2; xcell=60 places the domain end at x=300 while the Gaussian channel sits at xc=100 with sigma^2=2500 — see rip_tracking record for the same observations
